<color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability</color>
When there's at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Belobog Heavy Industries</color> characters in your squad: <color=#FFFFFF>Bangboo Chain Attack</color> DMG increases by 20%. If the target is <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> or <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color>, this buff increases by an additional 20%.
